speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our assessment, could you please describe exactly how your gait and limb ataxia started and how long these symptoms have been present?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you experience any recent head trauma, or have you noticed any other symptoms like speech difficulties, vision changes, or facial drooping? I also need to know if you have a history of hypertension, diabetes, or atrial fibrillation.

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and natalizumab use, I am concerned about the risk of Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). Have you experienced any cognitive changes, such as memory loss, personality changes, or confusion, alongside your motor symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had a recent fever or major infection that I know of. The symptoms are mostly gait imbalance, limb ataxia, and weaker use of my right arm.

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML)
